name: Release Notes
description: Compile user-facing release notes and upgrade notes from git history, PRs, and changelogs.

promptPatterns: \b(release notes|发布说明|changelog|版本说明|upgrade notes)\b

commands.description: Generate release notes from git history
commands.injectPrompt: Apply the release-notes skill: analyze git log between versions, categorize changes (features/fixes/breaking), and produce polished user-facing release notes with upgrade guidance.
